note: The bag prints no coffee name at all — just the region, repeated, and the 'direto do produtor' tagline. Roast is invented from 'Acidez: Média' (this bag has no roast line at all) because ROAST_TERMS treats bare 'média' as Medium roast, colliding with medium acidity. Notes come out as a garbled, half-translated run-on rather than the clean Portuguese sentence the bag actually prints. Altitude is genuinely recoverable — one OCR pass keeps the leading digit ('1000m') even though the other drops it (both read 'média .000m').
